title: Never get booked into a wall
body: Set the least notice you will accept, a buffer either side of a meeting, and a limit on how many land in one day. Tempo refuses the rest before you have to.

title: A link people remember
body: Your booking page lives on a short address you choose, not a string of characters nobody can read out loud.

title: Let them see their own week
body: Bookers can lay their calendar over yours, so they pick a time that is free for both of you on the first try.

title: Fewer no-shows, and no chasing
body: A reminder goes out by email or text before the meeting, and a follow-up after it, without you opening anything.
